blocks.explanation:
Upar degree 4, neeche degree 3: improper. Neeche \((x - 3)\) ek dafa aur \((x + 2)\) do dafa.
Pehle long division, phir remainder ke liye Case I aur Case II mila kar.
Plan: denominator kholna, long division, identity, \(x = 3\) aur \(x = -2\) rakhna, coefficients compare, aur jor kar tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{2x^4}{(x - 3)(x + 2)^2}\)
Maloom karna hai: is ke partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Improper hai, to fraction = quotient + remainder/denominator. Phir proper hissa: \((x - 3)\) ka ek fraction aur \((x + 2)^2\) ke do. Yeh is exercise ka sab se lamba sawal hai, is liye har qadam saaf likhein.

Denominator khol kar likhein
\[(x + 2)^2 = x^2 + 4x + 4\]
\[(x - 3)(x^2 + 4x + 4)\]
\[= x^3 + x^2 - 8x - 12\]
Kyun: Long division ke liye divisor polynomial ki shakal mein chahiye. \(4x - 3x = x^2\) wala term, \(4x - 12x = -8x\) aur \(-3 \cdot 4 = -12\).

\(2x^4\) ki \(x^3 + x^2 - 8x - 12\) se long division
\[2x^4 \div x^3 = 2x\]
\[2x(\ldots) = 2x^4 + 2x^3 - 16x^2 - 24x\]
Tafreeq: \(-2x^3 + 16x^2 + 24x\)
\[-2x^3 \div x^3 = -2\]
\[-2(\ldots) = -2x^3 - 2x^2 + 16x + 24\]
Tafreeq: \(18x^2 + 8x - 24\)
Kyun: Remainder ki degree (2) divisor ki degree (3) se kam ho gayi, is liye ruk gaye. Quotient \(2x - 2\).
Dhyan dein: \(2x^4\) mein baaqi powers zero hain; tafreeq mein \(0 - 2x^3 = -2x^3\), \(0 - (-16x^2) = 16x^2\).

Shakal aur identity likhein
\[\dfrac{18x^2 + 8x - 24}{(x - 3)(x + 2)^2}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 2} + \dfrac{C}{(x + 2)^2}\]
\[18x^2 + 8x - 24 = A(x + 2)^2\]
\[+ B(x - 3)(x + 2) + C(x - 3) \quad (i)\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \((x - 3)(x + 2)^2\) se multiply kiya; har constant ke saath woh hissa bacha jo us ke fraction mein nahi tha.

\(A\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = 3\) rakhein
\[162 + 24 - 24 = A(25)\]
\[A = \tfrac{162}{25}\]
Kyun: \(x - 3 = 0\), to \(B\) aur \(C\) wale terms khatam. \(18 \times 9 = 162\) aur \((3 + 2)^2 = 25\).

\(B\) ke liye coefficients compare karein
\[x^2:\ A + B = 18\]
\[B = \tfrac{450}{25} - \tfrac{162}{25} = \tfrac{288}{25}\]
Constant ki tasdeeq: \(4A - 6B - 3C\)
\[= \tfrac{648}{25} - \tfrac{1728}{25} + \tfrac{480}{25}\]
\[= -\tfrac{600}{25} = -24 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(x^2\) daayen taraf \(A(x + 2)^2\) aur \(B(x - 3)(x + 2)\) se aata hai, \(C(x - 3)\) mein \(x^2\) nahi. 18 ko \(\tfrac{450}{25}\) likha taake tafreeq aasan ho.

Jawab likhein
\[= 2x - 2 + \dfrac{162}{25(x - 3)}\]
\[+ \dfrac{288}{25(x + 2)} - \dfrac{32}{5(x + 2)^2}\]
Kyun: Quotient aur teen partial fractions mila kar poora jawab. Quotient \(2x - 2\) shuru mein likhein taake parhne wale ko foran pata chale ke fraction improper tha.

Tasdeeq: fractions wapas jor kar dekhein
\(25(x - 3)(x + 2)^2\) par proper hisse ka numerator:
\[162(x^2 + 4x + 4) + 288(x^2 - x - 6)\]
\[- 160(x - 3)\]
\[= 450x^2 + 200x - 600\]
\[= 25(18x^2 + 8x - 24) \;\checkmark\]
Aur \((2x - 2)(x^3 + x^2 - 8x - 12)\)
\[+ 18x^2 + 8x - 24 = 2x^4 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\tfrac{32}{5} = \tfrac{160}{25}\). Fractions jor kar remainder mila, aur quotient guna divisor jama remainder se \(2x^4\) wapas aa gaya, yani division bhi sahi thi.
